Theorem
[Type II models with positive Ricci curvature are steady solitons] Source: cao-zhu ↗ thm:cz-matrix-liyauhamilton-estimate 1. Theorem 4.3.6\group Cao–Zhu Limiting Singularity Models

  • (Hamilton \cite{Ha93E}) Any Type II singularity model with nonnegative curvature operator and positive Ricci curvature to the Ricci flow on a manifold $M$ must be a $($steady$)$ Ricci soliton.

  • (Chen-Zhu \cite{CZ00}) Any Type III singularity model with nonnegative curvature operator and positive Ricci curvature on a manifold $M$ must be a homothetically expanding Ricci soliton.
